column1: # Rows db.x1bo.* (line RG, X1b-o, 2026-11-17): BLASTN -ungapped -xdrop_ungap 1e10 (X-drop INT_MIN) with -subject, whose ungapped walk passes two sentinels (Int4 wrap) into an earlier query context (tests/fasta/outfmt0/x1bo_q.fna: qA 1000 and qB 300 letters; x1bo_d2/d3/d5_s.fna, written by remaining-gaps X/x1bo/scripts/gen_x1bo.py as d2, d3 and d5): NCBI re-evaluates the HSP from its negative start (blast_hits.c:676-735); the rows .below and .more keep an HSP in the context, the .rej rows are LOSAT's refusal where NCBI keeps the piece before the context (NCBI then stops with CAnnotMapperException, exit 255). Round 4 (2026-11-17): the HSP left of its context is kept through the later stages and refused only where it reaches the report; the .drop rows (x1bo_d6_s.fna, gen_x1bo.py d6) drop it with -evalue, -perc_identity, -max_hsps, -max_target_seqs and -qcov_hsp_perc (NCBI writes its report), and -culling_limit keeps it. Round 5 (2026-11-17, review 1): the right side and megablast (tests/fasta/outfmt0/x1bo_rv_q.fna: qA 60, qB 30 and qC 400 letters; x1bo_r2_s.fna and x1bo_r3_s.fna, written by remaining-gaps X/x1bo/review1/gen_rv1.py as rv_r2_s and rv_r3_s): one refusal for an HSP outside its query context on either side, where NCBI stops with CAnnotMapperException (exit 255: the .r3.*.rej rows) and where it shows coordinates past the query's end (the .r2.*.rej rows, the LOSAT gap of item X1b-p); the .r3.mb rows are NCBI's in-context alignment from a megablast greedy seed past its context's end (blast_gapalign.c:4012-4017, greedy_align.c); the .split rows split the query batch (CHUNK_SIZE=200 OVERLAP_CHUNK_SIZE=30), whose chunks' HSPs map onto the batch with NCBI's unchecked offsets (blast_hspstream.c:476-522). Round 6 (2026-11-17, review 2): the .rshort and .rlong rows (tests/fasta/outfmt0/x1bo_R_q.fna: qA 60, qB 30 and qC 16000 letters; x1bo_R_short_s.fna and x1bo_R_long_s.fna, the second with 100000 letters added, written by remaining-gaps X/x1bo/review2/gen_rv2.py as R_*): a megablast traceback start more than 3000 letters past its context's end, also on a subject of 90000 letters or more, where AdjustSubjectRange gives it a range shorter than its start (blast_gapalign.c:4163-4191) and the greedy alignment still runs to its left.

column12: covers

RG-X1b-o: the B+ hit starts at the sentinel between A+ and A- (every letter before qB+ mismatches on its diagonal), so the part before the context re-evaluates below the cutoff and NCBI's HSP is qB 1-40 in its context (blast_hits.c:699-715; the report is that of the default X-drop)

RG-X1b-o: the B+ hit starts at qA+ 921 (80 letters of qA's tail match the subject before the two sentinels): that part reaches the cutoff, and qB's 300 letters score more, so NCBI's HSP is qB 1-300 in its context (the report is that of the default X-drop)

RG-X1b-o: as .more, with 200 letters of qA's tail and 40 of qB: the re-evaluation keeps the piece in qA+ (it scores more than qB's), an HSP of context qB+ with a negative query start, on which NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 stops with CAnnotMapperException (exit 255), which LOSAT does not reproduce yet | expect: an HSP that NCBI BLAST+ keeps outside its query context
RG-X1b-o: db.x1bo.bn.left.rej with -task megablast (NCBI: CAnnotMapperException, exit 255) | expect: an HSP that NCBI BLAST+ keeps outside its query context

RG-X1b-o round 4: on s6a the re-evaluation keeps the piece of qB+'s HSP in qA+ (50 letters, 80 % identical, at about -52 in context qB+), which reaches the report (NCBI: CAnnotMapperException, exit 255); the .drop rows below drop it | expect: an HSP that NCBI BLAST+ keeps outside its query context
RG-X1b-o round 4: db.x1bo.bn.drop.rej with an e-value threshold that the HSP left of its context misses
RG-X1b-o round 4: db.x1bo.bn.drop.rej with a percent identity that the HSP left of its context misses (its identities are its letters in qA+)
RG-X1b-o round 4: db.x1bo.bn.drop.rej with one HSP per subject (qB's B[100:300] on s6a scores more)
RG-X1b-o round 4: db.x1bo.bn.drop.rej with one subject per query (qB's best is s6b)
RG-X1b-o round 4: db.x1bo.bn.drop.rej with a query coverage that the HSP left of its context (50 of 300 letters) misses

RG-X1b-o round 4: db.x1bo.bn.drop.rej with -culling_limit 1, which keeps the HSP left of its context: its query range overlaps no other HSP's (NCBI: CAnnotMapperException, exit 255) | expect: an HSP that NCBI BLAST+ keeps outside its query context

RG-X1b-o round 5 (review 1 M1): the qB- hit runs right of its context through qC+ into qC-, and the re-evaluation keeps the part in qC-, an HSP of qB- whose end is past its context's end (a minus-strand query start below 1), on which NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 stops with CAnnotMapperException (seq_align_mapper_base.cpp:1292, exit 255) | expect: an HSP that NCBI BLAST+ keeps outside its query context
RG-X1b-o round 5: db.x1bo.r3.ush.rej with -task megablast (NCBI: CAnnotMapperException at seq_align_mapper_base.cpp:2902, exit 255) | expect: an HSP that NCBI BLAST+ keeps outside its query context

RG-X1b-o round 5: the qB+ hit runs right of its context into qC+, and the re-evaluation keeps that part, a plus-strand HSP whose end is past its context's end; NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 writes it with query coordinates 63-462 past qB's 30 letters (exit 0; RG-X1b-p)

RG-X1b-o round 5 (review 1 M2): the megablast greedy alignment from the middle of the qB+ hit of db.x1bo.r2.ubn.6, a seed past qB+'s end, stays in qC+; NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 writes it with query coordinates 63-131 (exit 0; RG-X1b-p)

RG-X1b-o round 5 (review 1 M2): the megablast greedy alignment from the middle of the qB- hit of db.x1bo.r3.ush.rej, a seed past qB-'s end, reads back through the sentinel into qB- (greedy_align.c), and the traceback from its start gives NCBI's HSP qB 1-30 in its context
RG-X1b-o round 5: db.x1bo.r3.mb.6 as the pairwise report

RG-X1b-o round 5: db.x1bo.r2.mb.6 with the query batch split (CHUNK_SIZE=200 OVERLAP_CHUNK_SIZE=30): a chunk's query block puts other contexts next to qB, its HSPs keep NCBI's offsets relative to their part when they map onto the batch (blast_hspstream.c:476-522 adds them unchecked, also outside the context), and NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 writes qB 1-30 and qC 1-400 (LOSAT before this item wrote other rows)
RG-X1b-o round 5: db.x1bo.r3.mb.6 with the query batch split as in db.x1bo.split.r2.mb.6: NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 writes qB 1-30 and qC 101-400 (LOSAT before this item wrote other rows)

RG-X1b-o round 6 (review 2 M1): the qB+ hit of db.x1bo.r2.mb.6 with a qC of 16000 letters: the megablast traceback starts at qB+ offset 4031, 4001 letters past qB's end, and aligns back to offset 62; NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 writes it with query coordinates 63-4031 (exit 0; RG-X1b-p)

RG-X1b-o round 6: db.x1bo.rshort.mb.6 with 100000 letters added to the subject (116154 letters): AdjustSubjectRange (blast_gapalign.c:4163-4191) gives the traceback a subject range of 3092 letters, shorter than its start 4093, and the greedy aligns to the left only, the same HSP (NCBI: the same row, exit 0; RG-X1b-p); LOSAT left it out without a message before X1b-o
